review.reason: Candidate 10 passes as supplied. Hole 1 is a 173-yard punchbowl par 3 with a substantial front-right water hazard and greenside bunkers on both sides. The separate landing area and playable target allow a measured center-green shot, while a direct attack requires more precise carry and distance control. Hole 2 is a dry 473-yard dogleg-right par 5. Its bending route, collision trees and fairway bunkers give the two-shot opportunity meaningful risk; staged play remains a credible alternative. Hole 3 is a dry 360-yard double-dogleg par 4, where the bends and fairway hazards reward placement rather than an indiscriminate straight-line attack. The par-3/5/4 sequence, one wet target, and two contrasting dry routes provide strong variety. Punchbowl greens and double doglegs have appeared recently, but this combination, sequence, and single-water-hole emphasis distinguish the round sufficiently. The simulation supports playability at 1/2/2 shots to green, with 33/50/58 safe tee options; the previews also show usable target and landing space. No geometry edits are needed.
